_comment: EMAILGATESUBST1116: the shared contract of unverifiable_send_construction (outgoing-copy-gate.py, used by the copy gate and email-approval-gate.py) and unverifiableSendConstruction (email-send-gate.mjs, the sub-agent gate): a send command built by process substitution, a here-string, a stdin heredoc or xargs is refused as unverifiable, and (EMAILGATEPIPESH1116) so is a send whose command text a producer (echo, printf, a copier, a group of them) pipes or hands to a shell, or that parallel builds. The conformance test (unverifiable-construction-conformance.test.ts) writes the fixture files of script-run-cases.json into a fresh directory and runs EVERY case from it through BOTH implementations; both must equal `expected`. Commands are input data only, nothing is executed.
